physicalNotes: Radius 1.228 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Chaturvedi et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-3493 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract): 854,320 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.023 +/- 0.041 solar masses from Chaturvedi et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-3493 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5844 +/- 42 K from Chaturvedi et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-3493 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
